3700: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and arms ready.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms up.
Jump as high as you can and pull your knees toward your chest.
Land softly on the balls of your feet with bent knees.
3701: Stand tall with your arms bent at your sides.
Start running in place, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms in rhythm with your legs.
Stay on the balls of your feet and keep your chest up.
Go hard for 20 to 30 seconds, then rest.
3702: Stand tall and raise both arms straight overhead.
Step one foot forward into a lunge and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Pulse up and down a few inches in the low position.
3703: Start in a deep squat with your hands on the floor.
Jump or step your feet back into a plank.
Hop your feet to the outside of your hands.
Stand up or jump up from the squat.
Repeat at a steady quick pace.
3704: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat and explode into a jump.
Land softly and immediately jump a second time.
Land with bent knees and sink back into the squat.
Keep your chest up and repeat.
3705: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Stand up and repeat at a steady pace.
3706: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Lower into a squat with your arms back.
Explode upward and pull your knees toward your chest.
Sink straight into the next squat and repeat.
3707: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Squat down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Use that momentum to press the dumbbells overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and go into the next squat.
3708: Stand tall with your hands on your hips or swinging with the movement.
Step forward and lower into a lunge.
Push off the front foot and return to standing.
Switch legs and keep a quick rhythm.
3709: Press two dumbbells overhead with your arms straight.
Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Sit down into a squat while keeping the weights above your head.
Keep your chest up and ribs down.
Stand back up, driving through your heels.
3710: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and place your front foot on a bosu ball, back foot behind you.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Press through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3711: Stand facing a sturdy box or bench.
Place one foot fully on it.
Drive through that heel to stand tall on the box.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3712: Stand on one foot and hold a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Lower slowly below flat if you can do so comfortably.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3713: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on the opposite leg, lightly touching a wall for balance.
Rise up onto the ball of your foot as high as you can.
Lower your heel slowly below the start if possible.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3714: Stand tall with your feet together.
Lift one foot off the floor and bend the knee slightly.
Keep your hips level and eyes on a fixed point.
3715: Place a bosu ball dome-up in front of you.
Step onto it with one foot near the center.
Lift your other foot and hold it off the ground.
Keep your hips level and your core tight.
Hold for 20 to 30 seconds, then switch legs.
3716: Start in a split stance with your torso upright.
Lower into a split squat until the front thigh is parallel.
Sit back and roll onto your back with control.
Roll up and return to the split stance.
Stand and repeat, then switch legs.
3718: Stand with feet wide and toes forward.
Shift your weight to one side and squat on that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Roll back with control and roll up again.
3719: Set a cable to a high position and hold the handle with one hand.
Stand facing the machine with your elbow bent and tucked.
Press the handle down and across your body until your arm is straight.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
3720: Stand at the bottom of a staircase with your feet together.
Bend your knees and swing your arms back.
Jump up onto a step, landing softly with both feet.
3721: Hold a barbell with a wide overhand grip and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let the bar hang at arm length below your chest.
Pull the bar toward your lower chest, flaring your elbows.
3722: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell hanging below you.
Raise the bar by lifting your elbows out and back.
Squeeze your rear delts at the top.
3723: Rest a barbell across your upper back and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other, like a curtsey.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand.
Alternate sides or finish one side first.
3724: Lie on the floor with your knees bent and a barbell set above your chest.
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width.
Lower the bar until your upper arms touch the floor.
Press the bar back up to full extension.
3725: Press a barbell overhead and hold it with straight arms.
Lower until both knees are around 90 degrees.
Push off your front foot back to standing.
Alternate legs and keep the bar steady.
3726: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an overhand grip, resting on your thighs.
Raise the bar straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly to your thighs.
Keep your back straight and avoid swinging.
3727: Place a bench behind you and rest the bar across your front shoulders.
Keep your elbows high and your chest up.
Sit back and down until you lightly touch the bench.
Drive through your feet to stand.
Avoid rocking or collapsing onto the bench.
3728: Rack a barbell across your front shoulders and stand facing a box.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up and stand tall.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3729: Sit on a stability ball and walk your feet out until your upper back rests on it.
Keep your hips up and take the barbell above your chest.
Lower the bar to your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.
3730: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with straight arms.
Keep your chest up and shoulders relaxed.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.
3731: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a wide stance and toes turned out.
Push your hips back, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
3732: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3733: Stand holding a kettlebell with both hands in front of your thighs.
Keep your legs almost straight with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and lower the bell along your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand.
3734: Hold a kettlebell and stand with one foot slightly behind, toes on the ground as a kickstand.
Hinge at the hips over your front leg.
Lower the bell toward the floor with a flat back.
Drive through your front heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3735: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell with both hands above your chest.
Lower the bell back over your head in an arc.
Stop when you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull it back over your chest.
3736: Hold a kettlebell upside down by the handle at shoulder height.
Squeeze the handle and brace your core.
Press the bell straight overhead, keeping it balanced.
Lower it back to your shoulder with control.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
3737: Sit on a bench with a kettlebell held at your shoulder.
Sit tall with your core braced.
Press the bell straight overhead until your arm is straight.
Lower it slowly to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
3738: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell above your chest.
Keep your wrist straight and your feet planted.
Lower the bell to the side of your chest.
Press it back up to full extension.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
3739: Lie on a bench holding a kettlebell upside down above your chest.
Squeeze the handle and keep your wrist stacked.
Lower the bell slowly toward your chest.
Press it back up while keeping it balanced.
Use a light weight and switch arms after your reps.
3740: Stand holding a kettlebell in one hand at your side.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
3741: Hold a towel with both hands and stand on its middle with one foot, or pull its ends apart.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Keep tension on the towel throughout.
3742: Lie on your back with your heels on towels on a smooth floor.
Lift your hips off the ground.
Slide your heels toward your butt, curling your legs.
3743: Stand facing away from a chair and rest the top of one foot on it.
Step your front foot forward so it is stable.
Lower your back knee toward the floor.
Push through your front foot to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3744: Hold a bed sheet taut in both hands in front of you.
Pull your hands apart, opening your arms out to the sides.
Return slowly and keep tension on the sheet.
3745: Hold a bed sheet with both hands behind your head, one hand pulling up, one down.
Press your top hand overhead against the resistance.
Finish your reps, then swap hand positions.
3746: Loop a bed sheet around a sturdy anchor and hold the ends.
Lean back with your arms straight.
Pull your hands toward your chest, elbows flared out.
3747: Hold the ends of a bed sheet anchored to a door or post.
Stand on one leg with the other leg extended forward.
Sit down on your standing leg, using the sheet as support.
Lower as far as you can control.
Push up to stand and switch legs after your reps.
3748: Hold a bed sheet with both hands, one arm pulling down, the other curling up.
Keep your elbow at your side.
Curl the working hand toward your shoulder against the resistance.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.
3749: Anchor a bed sheet securely and hold both ends.
Lean back with your body straight.
Pull your chest toward your hands.
3750: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Hop both feet a short way to one side.
Hop them back to the other side.
Keep your shoulders stable and your hips low.
3751: Sit on the floor and place your hands behind you, fingers pointing toward your hips.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Bend your elbows and lower your hips.
Press back up to straight arms.
3752: Lie on your back and wrap a towel around both feet, holding the ends.
Lift your legs slightly and press them against the towel.
Curl the towel toward your chest while your legs resist.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
3757: Anchor a band high and hold one end in each hand, facing away.
Bring your hands together in front of your waist with a soft elbow.
Squeeze your chest at the end.
3758: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands at chest level.
Push the handles forward until your arms are fully extended, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back towards your chest, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3759: Adjust the seat height so that your hips are slightly higher than your knees.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the footrests.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the seat for stability.
Keeping your back straight, slowly lean forward from your hips until your upper body is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position by pushing through your glutes and hamstrings.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3760: Sit on the leverage machine with your back against the pad and your feet secured under the footpads.
Place your hands on the handles or the sides of the seat for support.
Engage your abs and slowly crunch forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your abs.
Slowly return to the starting position, allowing your back to round slightly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3761: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up to shoulder height.
3764: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging.
Keep your shoulders against the bench.
Curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.
3765: Stand facing a sturdy box or step.
Drive through it and jump up into the air.
Land softly on the box and step back down.
Switch legs and keep a steady rhythm.
3767: Hold a dumbbell at your chest and stand on one leg.
Extend your other leg in front of you.
Lower into a squat as far as you can control.
Push through your heel to stand.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
3768: Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and feet on the platform.
Release the safety and press the platform away.
Stop just before your knees lock.
Lower the weight slowly until your knees are bent about 90 degrees.
Keep your hips down and your back flat on the pad.
3769: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step diagonally behind and across your body with your right foot, crossing it behind your left leg.
Bend both knees as if you were curtsying, lowering your body towards the ground.
Keep your torso upright and your weight on your front foot.
Push through your front foot to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping diagonally behind and across your body with your left foot.
3770: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and the band under light tension.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat while keeping your chest up.
Stand up and, at the top, pull the handle to your ribs with your elbow close to your body, then let it return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3771: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand with soft knees and the band under light tension.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then row the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3772: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Step back into a lunge and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and drive the rear knee up to hip height.
Row the handle to your ribs while balancing on one leg.
Return to the start under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3773: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee and the band under light tension.
Hinge forward at the hips while the free leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle and stand tall again. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3774: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest, then press it straight out.
Keep your hips and shoulders square as you squat down.
Stand back up while holding the band steady.
Complete your reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.
3775: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.
3776: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Press the handle straight out and sink into a quarter squat.
Take small steps sideways away from the anchor, keeping your torso square.
Repeat for your set, then switch sides.
3777: Anchor the band overhead and set up in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Pull the band down with one hand toward your hip without twisting.
Return the arm slowly to the start.
Alternate arms and keep your body in one straight line.
3778: Lie on your back with the band anchored behind your head, a handle in each hand.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Alternate pulling one handle toward your opposite knee in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue at a steady pace for your set.
3779: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.
3780: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold the handles at your chest.
Stand in a staggered stance with your core braced.
Press both hands forward until your arms are straight.
Pause briefly, then return slowly to your chest.
Keep your shoulders down and your back still.
3781: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a split stance with a slight bend in both knees.
Jump up and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance and row the handle to your ribs.
Alternate legs, and switch rowing arm for the next set.
3782: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a lunge position with your chest up.
Jump and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge and pull the handle to your ribs.
Keep your front knee over your ankle on each landing.
Switch rowing arm for the next set.
3783: Stand with feet wide and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Shift your weight toward the empty-hand side and bend that knee.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, keeping the other leg straight.
Lower with control and shift back to the center.
Repeat all reps, then switch arms.
3784: Start in a high plank with your hands crossed under your chest.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your chest toward the floor with your elbows close.
Press back up until your arms are straight.
Switch which hand is on top each set.
3785: Place your hands on the edge of a box or elevated surface, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on the balls of your feet, creating a straight line from your head to your heels.
Lower your chest towards the box by bending your elbows, keeping your body in a straight line.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
3786: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart and the band under light tension.
Sit your hips back and down into a squat while keeping your chest up.
Stand up and, at the top, pull the handle to your ribs with your elbow close to your body, then let it return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3787: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand with soft knees and the band under light tension.
Push your hips back and lower your torso with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then row the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3788: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Step back into a lunge and lower until your front thigh is about parallel.
Push through your front foot and drive the rear knee up to hip height.
Row the handle to your ribs while balancing on one leg.
Return to the start under control. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3789: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Stand on one leg with a soft knee and the band under light tension.
Hinge forward at the hips while the free leg extends behind you.
Keep your back flat, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Lower the handle and stand tall again. Finish your reps, then switch sides.
3790: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Press the handle straight out and sink into a quarter squat.
Take small steps sideways away from the anchor, keeping your torso square.
Repeat for your set, then switch sides.
3791: Anchor the band overhead and set up in a forearm or high plank.
Brace your abs and keep your hips level.
Pull the band down with one hand toward your hip without twisting.
Return the arm slowly to the start.
Alternate arms and keep your body in one straight line.
3792: Lie on your back with the band anchored behind your head, a handle in each hand.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Alternate pulling one handle toward your opposite knee in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed down.
Continue at a steady pace for your set.
3793: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a split stance with a slight bend in both knees.
Jump up and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in the opposite split stance and row the handle to your ribs.
Alternate legs, and switch rowing arm for the next set.
3794: Anchor the band at a low point and hold the handle in one hand.
Start in a lunge position with your chest up.
Jump and switch legs in mid-air.
Land softly in a lunge and pull the handle to your ribs.
Keep your front knee over your ankle on each landing.
Switch rowing arm for the next set.
3795: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.
3796: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest, then press it straight out.
Keep your hips and shoulders square as you squat down.
Stand back up while holding the band steady.
Complete your reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.
3797: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Take a split stance and press the handle straight out with both hands.
Lower your back knee toward the floor without letting the band twist you.
Push through your front foot to rise.
Finish your reps, then switch legs and anchor side.
3798: Anchor the band behind you and hold a handle in each hand at your shoulders.
Stand in a staggered stance with a braced core.
Punch one hand forward and rotate your torso slightly.
Return the hand and punch with the other side.
Keep the movement quick but controlled.
3799: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing forward.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and let the weights hang.
Pull the dumbbells to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
